description: This is a Java source file defining the class 'KeyLoader', a utility class for loading cryptographic keys and certificates from various sources such as key stores and PEM files. It provides methods for extracting private keys, public keys, and certificate chains, supporting multiple formats like JKS and PKCS12. The class is part of the package 'org.eclipse.hono.config' and uses Vert.x for asynchronous file operations.

classes.name: KeyLoader
classes.description: A utility class for loading cryptographic keys and certificates from key stores or PEM files.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Returns the loaded private key, or null if none is loaded.

methods.name: getCertificateChain
methods.description: Returns the chain of certificates, or null if none are loaded.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Returns the public key associated with the certificate chain, or null if not available.

methods.name: fromKeyStore
methods.description: Creates a KeyLoader instance by loading keys from a key store at the specified path.

methods.name: fromFiles
methods.description: Creates a KeyLoader instance by loading a private key and certificate chain from PEM files.
